reviews.reason: Numbered 10 is on PDF p.241, printed p.203, and ends before the explicit XCVIII heading. It is therefore XCVII.10, not the beginning of chapter 98. The proposed positive ይትነበር is not acceptable: the body visibly begins this verb with negative ኢ-, read as ኢይነብር. Grammatically, ኢ- negates the following imperfect; with ብዕል as the singular subject and *ለክሙ expressing the possessors, the clause means that wealth will not remain with them. The following connective appears to be እላ, contrasted with g's እለ in apparatus note 3, rather than supplied ኧሳ. The former supports an adversative 'but'; the latter is not interchangeable without grammatical reassessment. I cannot establish that vowel-order distinction and every remaining glyph of the complete unit with sufficient confidence for an exact replacement transcription. Consequently no complete translation is supplied. All ten units and the chapter boundary were inspected, but the unresolved exact transcription prevents marking the chapter complete.
